notes.title: Update - Chinese (Simplified) Added
notes.content:
Hi All!

We've just updated the game and added a new language option - Chinese (Simplified).
We've fixed a few minor bugs here and there too.

Hope you enjoy it and thanks for all of the feedback so far.
